page.layout: One printed page: an oval engraved portrait with its legend running around the oval (CAROLVS V. D. G. ROMAN. IMP. SEMPER AVG.), and below the portrait a four-line verse caption set in italic in the lower right of the page.
page.l: CAROLVS V. D. G. ROMAN. IMP. SEMPER AVG.
page.p: Romanŭ Imperŭ cesit mihi summa potestas, Et vires sensere meas, Papa, Gallus, Iberus, Saxo, Hessus, Clivius, Turcaque exosa prapago. Felix, heu nimium felix! si turbida tantum Numquam laesissent nostros diplomata cives.
page.notes: Engraving: half-length portrait of Emperor Charles V in an oval frame with stars above. The verse caption is printed as four and a half lines in italic; the legend is read as printed around the oval. Doubtful readings in the caption: "Romanŭ" (the mark over u as printed), "Imperŭ", "cesit" (as printed for cessit), "prapago" (as printed), "sensere" and "exosa" are uncertain at the scan edge; "laesissent" and "diplomata" are copied as printed, with "lesissent" possibly misread.
